page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin (a reference "Prou. 8.22.", and three notes: "De Synodis adversus Arianos, cap. 5.", "*Contra Eunomium lib. 3." with "†Comment. ad Ephes."). Running head at top; page number 266 at top left of the text.

main_text.p: denique verus Deus & vita æterna nominatur. Ac tandem aduersus hæreticorum errores concludens, Sacrarum literarum præstantiam & perfectionem, hisce verbis, ostendit; Nam si Sacris literis id non acceperunt, confundantur, proprias in fidem sententias afferentes. Deinde ad alterum locum, De die autem illa neque filius nouit, nisi solus Pater, Gregorius Nazianzenus orat. 2. de Filio, & ante eum Athanasius sermone 4. contra Arianos, Filio ignorantiam tribui non absolutè, sed tantùm ratione humanæ naturæ, petita ex Sacris literis interpretatione, exponunt. Denique ad tertium quod attinet locum, quem nobis obijcis, Dominus creauit me in initio operum suorum, iuxta septuaginta interpretes, si pattes ipsos audimus, non aliunde, quàm ex eadem Scriptura, interpretationem veram, & hæreticorum confutationem, hauserunt. Nam primùm Hilarius ex consequentibus Salomonis verbis, docet, sapientiam genitam dici; deinde De Synodis aduersus Arianos, cap. 5. * Basilius & † Hieronymus respondent ex Hebræo contextu & accuratioribus inter-
* Contra Eunomium lib. 3. † Comment. ad Ephes.

page.notes: Marginal reference "Prou. 8.22." beside the line "Deinde ad alterum locum" is partly faded; the words "Nam si" in the first lines and the Greek-looking ligature in "Dominus" are doubtful. The word "pattes" appears as printed; "Hieronymus" as printed "Hicronymus". The last line is partly cut off ("inter-" continues on the next page).
